text:
ida: Quick ask from CloudScale: they want a private marketplace SKU that bundles a 12mo commit + "hardware rebate annex" redeemable via partner portal, plus a managed SI package. Need: pricing ladder, how rebate appears on PO, amendment and renewal mechanics.

mark: Sales: suggested ladder (for discussion) — base 15% @ $120k, mid 23% + $18k rebate @ $300k, top 31% + $40k rebate @ $700k. Include a 60-day POC ramp credit capped at $12k. Field wants clear net savings shown for procurement.

sophie: Legal: can do rebate annex but requires expiry (90 days), non-transferable, clawback language if commit not hit. also need logo usage signoff for joint announcement. i'll draft annex language.

ben: Finance: prefer to book rebate as deferred subsidy amortized monthly. if sales wants invoice-level reduction, require reconciliation and CAF. want a defined amendment flow for mid-term increases.

ida: ops: marketplace metadata options: (1) show gross price + metadata rebate_estimate, (2) display net price if partner integration exists. ops leans to (1) to avoid integration work.

mark: field pushback: procurement prefers option (2). can we compromise with a visible "estimated net" line and link to voucher redemption terms?

ben: finance agrees to "estimated net" display if rebate recorded separately in accounting. also require a clawback schedule: recoup 50% in month 1, 25% in month 2, 25% in month 3 if commit not met.

sophie: noted. drafting: "rebate applied upon PO activation; recoupable per clawback schedule if final committed spend < target." will include a short early-renew accelerator clause (3% extra off if renewed 60+ days early, capped $35k).

ida: SI gating: must have SI runbook in place before final publish; we can publish a "preview" private-offer with "SI enablement pending" flag one week before announcement. any objections?

mark: preview ok but require final numbers locked for billing terms. field needs the ladder + voucher cap in writing.

ben: addendum: define amendment handling: increase commit mid-term -> pro-rata rate applies from amendment effective date; any added rebate credited and amortized over remaining term. i'll write the spreadsheet model.

acct-bot: Reminder: draft private-offer inserted into staging (id: po-cs-2024-1812223334). Review window opens in 48h.

marketplace-bot: Checklist added to draft: sku mapping, commit tiers, rebate_meta, SI_runbook_url (nullable), legal_annex_link.

ida: i'll collate legal annex + finance model + ops checklist and share a single Notion page by EOD. tagging @mark @sophie @ben. thanks everyone :sparkles:
